cases.adaptation: Chooses the 3.3 V TO-220 variant and a 5 V input. Adds an output connector.
cases.prompt: Draft a 3.3 V LM1117T-3.3/NOPB linear regulator from a 5 V supply. Put a 10 uF polarized capacitor on both the input and output, referenced to common ground. Expose the regulated output and ground on a two-pin connector.

cases.adaptation: Chooses the LM35DZ TO-92 package, a 5 V source, and a connector for the output and return.
cases.prompt: Wire an LM35DZ TO-92 as a basic single-supply temperature sensor. Power it from 5 V and bring out the analog voltage and ground to a two-pin header.

cases.adaptation: Uses the NAND feedback and reset pull-up from the published figure. A connector replaces the controller and the driven switch interface. The indicator load is omitted.
cases.prompt: Make an active-low SR latch with two gates of an SN74HC00N and a 5 V supply. Keep a 10 kohm pull-up on reset, expose set and reset on a header, and bring Q out on a separate connector. Ground the unused gates' inputs.
